content: {"praised":["Visually stunning color footage of WWII battles.","Emotionally overwhelming storytelling with strong voiceover work.","Well-structured narrative following twelve veterans' experiences.","Riveting 45‑minute episodes keep viewers engaged.","High production quality and historical accuracy."],"criticized":["Lacks coherent narrative, jumps between theaters randomly.","Focuses too much on soldiers' grief, little heroism.","Excessive gore and execution footage.","No closed captions for hard‑of‑hearing viewers.","Poor pacing due to random time jumps."]}
